info.description: Chenghe Acquisition III Co. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 4, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Chenghe Acquisition III Co.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月4日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Amgen, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of human therapeutics. The company was founded by William K. Bowes, Jr., Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr., George B. Rathmann, and Joseph Rubinfeld on April 8, 1980 and is headquartered in Thousand Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: 安進公司是一家生技公司，從事人類治療藥物的發現、開發、製造和行銷。該公司由 William K. Bowes, Jr.、Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr.、George B. Rathmann 和 Joseph Rubinfeld 於 1980 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州千橡市。

info.description: Cintas Corp. engages in the provision of corporate identity uniforms through rental and sales programs. It operates through the following segments: Uniform Rental and Facility Services, First Aid and Safety Services, and All Other. The Uniform Rental and Facility Services segment consists of the rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops and shop towels, and other ancillary items. The First Aid and Safety Services segment includes first aid and safety products and services. The All Other segment contains fire protection services and its direct sale business. The company was founded by Richard T. Farmer in 1968 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Cintas Corp. 透過租賃和銷售計劃提供企業形象制服。它透過以下部門運作：制服租賃和設施服務部門、急救和安全服務部門以及所有其他部門。制服租賃和設施服務部門包括制服和其他服裝的租賃和服務，包括阻燃服裝、墊子、拖把和抹布以及其他輔助物品。急救和安全服務部門包括急救和安全產品和服務。所有其他部門包括消防服務及其直銷業務。該公司由 Richard T. Farmer 於 1968 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事非常規、陸上石油和天然氣儲量的收購、開發、勘探和開採。它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Fastenal Co. engages in the distribution of fasteners and tools. It also operates hardware stores. The company was founded by Robert A. Kierlin, Michael M. Gostomski, Henry K. McConnon, John D. Remick, and Stephen M. Slaggie in November 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, MN.
info.description_zh: Fastenal Co. 從事緊固件和工具的分銷。它還經營五金店。該公司由 Robert A. Kierlin、Michael M. Gostomski、Henry K. McConnon、John D. Remick 和 Stephen M. Slaggie 於 1967 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州威諾納。

info.description: PACCAR, Inc. is a global technology company, which engages in the design and manufacture of light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks. It operates through the following segments: Truck, Parts, and Financial Services. The Truck segment designs and manufactures heavy, medium, and light duty diesel trucks which are marketed under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF brands. The Parts segment distributes aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. The Financial Services segment provides finance and leasing products and services provided to truck customers and dealers. The company was founded by William Pigott Sr. in 1905 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: PACCAR, Inc.是一家全球科技公司，從事輕型、中型和重型卡車的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：卡車部門、零件部門和金融服務部門。卡車部門設計和製造重型、中型和輕型柴油卡車，並以 Kenworth、Peterbilt 和 DAF 品牌銷售。零件部門分銷卡車和相關商用車的售後零件。金融服務部門為卡車客戶和經銷商提供融資和租賃產品及服務。該公司由 William Pigott Sr. 於 1905 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Abbott Laboratories engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of healthcare products. It operates through the following segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. The Established Pharmaceutical Products segment focuses on branded generic pharmaceuticals that are manufactured worldwide and marketed and sold outside the United States, primarily in emerging markets. The Diagnostic Products segment markets diagnostic systems and tests for blood banks, hospitals, commercial laboratories, clinics, physicians' offices, retailers, government agencies, and alternative care testing sites. The Nutritional Products segment oversees the worldwide sale of pediatric and adult nutritional products. The Medical Devices segment offers a broad range of rhythm management, electrophysiology, heart failure, vascular and structural heart devices for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, as well as diabetes care and continuous glucose monitoring products. It also provides neuromodulation devices for the management of chronic pain and movement disorders The company was founded by Wallace Calvin Abbott in 1888 and is headquartered in Abbott Park, IL.
info.description_zh: 雅培實驗室從事醫療保健產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：成熟的藥品部門、診斷產品部門、營養產品部門和醫療器材部門。老牌藥品部門專注於在全球生產並在美國境外（主要是新興市場）行銷和銷售的品牌仿製藥。診斷產品部門為血庫、醫院、商業實驗室、診所、醫生辦公室、零售商、政府機構和替代護理測試場所銷售診斷系統和測試。營養產品部門負責監督兒科和成人營養產品的全球銷售。醫療器材部門提供廣泛的節律管理、電生理學、心臟衰竭、用於治療心血管疾病的血管和結構性心臟設備，以及糖尿病護理和連續血糖監測產品。它還提供用於治療慢性疼痛和運動障礙的神經調節設備。該公司由 Wallace Calvin Abbott 於 1888 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州雅培公園。

info.description: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. engages in the provision of insurance brokerage, reinsurance brokerage, consulting, and third-party claims settlement and administration services. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage, Risk Management, and Corporate. The Brokerage segment consists of retail and wholesale insurance brokerage operations. The Risk Management segment provides contract claim settlement and administration services. The Corporate segment manages clean energy and other investments. The company was founded by Arthur J. Gallagher in 1927 and is headquartered in Rolling Meadows, IL.
info.description_zh: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. 從事提供保險經紀、再保險經紀、諮詢以及第三方索賠結算和管理服務。它透過以下部門運作：經紀部門、風險管理部門和企業部門。經紀部門包括零售和批發保險經紀業務。風險管理部門提供合約索賠結算和管理服務。公司部門管理清潔能源和其他投資。該公司由 Arthur J. Gallagher 於 1927 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州羅靈梅多斯。

info.description: The Allstate Corp. engages in the property and casualty insurance business and the provision of protection solutions. It operates through the following segments: Allstate Protection, Protection Services, Allstate Health and Benefits, Run-off Property-Liability, and Corporate and Other. The Allstate Protection segment offers private passenger auto, homeowners, other personal lines, and commercial insurance marketed under the Allstate, National General, and Answer Financial brand names. The Protection Services segment provides a range of solutions and services that expand and enhance customer value propositions including Allstate Protection Plans, Allstate Dealer Services, Allstate Roadside, Arity, and Allstate Identity Protection. The Allstate Health and Benefits segment focuses on voluntary benefits and individual life and health products, including life, accident, critical illness, short term disability, and other health insurance products sold through independent agents, benefit brokers, and Allstate exclusive agencies. The Run-off Property-Liability segment relates to property and casualty insurance policies with exposure to asbestos, environmental, and other claims in run-off. The Corporate and Other segment is involved in debt service, holding company activities, and certain non-insurance operations. The company was founded on April 17, 1931 and is headquartered in Northbrook, IL.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Allstate Corp. 從事財產和意外保險業務以及提供保障解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Allstate Protection、Protection Services、Allstate Health and Benefits、Run-off Property-Liability、以及Corporate and Other。 Allstate Protection 部門提供以 Allstate、National General 和 Answer Financial 品牌銷售的私人乘用車、房屋所有者、其他個人保險和商業保險。保護服務部門提供一系列解決方案和服務，可擴展和增強客戶價值主張，包括 Allstate 保護計畫、Allstate 經銷商服務、Allstate Roadside、Arity 和 Allstate 身分保護。 Allstate 健康和福利部門專注於自願福利以及個人人壽和健康產品，包括人壽、意外、重大疾病、短期殘疾以及透過獨立代理人、福利經紀人和 Allstate 獨家代理機構銷售的其他健康保險產品。徑流財產責任部分涉及財產和傷亡保險單，涉及石棉、環境和其他徑流索賠。公司及其他部門涉及償債、控股公司活動和某些非保險業務。該公司成立於 1931 年 4 月 17 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州諾斯布魯克。

info.description: Bank of America Corp. is a bank and financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking and nonbank financial services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth and Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, Global Markets, and All Other. The Consumer Banking segment offers credit, banking, and investment products and services to consumers and small businesses. The GWIM segment focuses on solutions to meet clients' needs through a full set of investment management, brokerage, banking, and retirement products. The Global Banking segment deals with lending-related products and services, integrated working capital management and treasury solutions to clients, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment includes sales and trading services, as well as research, to institutional clients across fixed-income, credit, currency, commodity, and equity businesses. The All Other segment consists of asset and liability management activities, equity investments, non-core mortgage loans and servicing activities, the net impact of periodic revisions to the mortgage servicing rights valuation model for both core and non-core MSRs, other liquidating businesses, residual expense allocations and other. The company was founded by Amadeo Peter Giannini in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: 美國銀行公司是一家銀行和金融控股公司，從事提供銀行和非銀行金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行部門、全球財富與投資管理部門 (GWIM)、全球銀行部門、全球市場部門和所有其他部門。消費者銀行業務部門為消費者及小型企業提供信貸、銀行及投資產品及服務。 GWIM 部門專注於透過全套投資管理、經紀、銀行和退休產品來滿足客戶需求的解決方案。全球銀行業務部門提供貸款相關產品和服務、綜合營運資金管理和客戶資金解決方案以及承銷和諮詢服務。全球市場部門包括向固定收益、信貸、貨幣、商品和股票業務的機構客戶提供銷售和交易服務以及研究。所有其他部門包括資產和負債管理活動、股權投資、非核心抵押貸款和服務活動、核心和非核心抵押貸款服務權估值模型定期修訂的淨影響、其他清算業務、剩餘費用分配等。該公司由 Amadeo Peter Giannini 於 1904 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Citigroup, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking (USPB), and All Other. The Services segment includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) which provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, trade, and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector organizations, and Securities Services, which offers cross-border support for clients, providing on-the-ground local market expertise, post-trade technologies, customized data solutions, and a wide range of securities services solutions that can be tailored to meet client needs. The Markets segment provides corporate, institutional, and public sector clients around the world with a full range of sales and trading services across equities, foreign exchange, rates, spread products, and commodities. The Banking segment offers Investment Banking and Corporate Lending services. The Wealth segment includes Private Bank, Wealth at Work, and Citigold and provides financial services to a range of client segments through banking, lending, mortgages, investment, custody, and trust product offerings. The USPB segment includes Branded Cards and Retail Services, which have proprietary card portfolios and co-branded card portfolios within Branded Cards, and co-brand and private label relationships within Retail Services. The All Other segment consists of activities not assigned to the reportable operating segments, including certain unallocated costs of global functions, other corporate expenses, and net treasury results. The company was founded in 1812 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 花旗集團是一家控股公司，從事提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：服務部門、市場部門、銀行部門、財富部門、美國個人銀行部門 (USPB) 和所有其他部門。服務部門包括資金和貿易解決方案（TTS），為跨國公司、金融機構和公共部門組織提供一整套量身定制的現金管理、貿易和營運資金解決方案；以及證券服務，為客戶提供跨境支持，提供實地本地市場專業知識、交易後技術、定制數據解決方案以及可根據客戶需求定制的廣泛證券服務解決方案。市場部門為世界各地的企業、機構和公共部門客戶提供涵蓋股票、外匯、利率、價差產品和大宗商品的全方位銷售和交易服務。銀行部門提供投資銀行和企業貸款服務。財富部門包括私人銀行、Wealth at Work 和 Citigold，透過銀行、貸款、抵押貸款、投資、託管和信託產品向一系列客戶群提供金融服務。 USPB 部門包括品牌卡和零售服務，其中在品牌卡內擁有專有卡組合和聯合品牌卡組合，以及零售服務內的聯合品牌和自有品牌關係。所有其他部門由未分配給可報告經營部門的活動組成，包括全球職能的某些未分配成本、其他公司費用和淨財務表現。該公司成立於 1812 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Medical segments. The Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products. The Medical segment manufactures, sources and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和醫療部門運作。製藥部門分銷品牌藥品和仿製藥、特殊藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。醫療部門生產、採購和分銷康德樂品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: Edison International is a renewable energy company, which through its subsidiaries, generates and distributes electric power, and invests in energy services and technologies. The company was founded on July 4, 1886, and is headquartered in Rosemead, CA.

info.description_zh: 愛迪生國際是一家再生能源公司，透過其子公司生產和分配電力，並投資能源服務和技術。該公司成立於 1886 年 7 月 4 日，總部位於加利福尼亞州羅斯米德。

info.description: Erie Indemnity Co. engages in the insurance business and operates as an attorney-in-fact. It manages affairs at the Erie Insurance Exchange for the benefit of the policyholders. It covers policies in auto and leisure, home and property, life, and business insurance. The company was founded by Henry Orth Hirt and Ollie Grover Crawford on April 4, 1925, and is headquartered in Erie, PA.
info.description_zh: 伊利賠償公司 (Erie Indemnity Co.) 從事保險業務，並作為事實上的律師開展業務。它為保單持有人的利益管理伊利保險交易所的事務。它涵蓋汽車和休閒、家庭和財產、人壽和商業保險的保單。該公司由 Henry Orth Hirt 和 Ollie Grover Crawford 於 1925 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊利。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Henry Schein, Inc. engages in the provision of health care products and services to medical, dental, and veterinary office-based practitioners. It operates through the Healthcare Distribution and Technology and Value-Added Services segments. The Healthcare Distribution segment includes consumable products, laboratory, small and large equipment repair services, branded and generic pharmaceuticals, vaccines, surgical, diagnostic tests, infection-control products, and vitamins. The Technology and Value-Added Services segment offers financial on a non-recourse basis, network, and hardware services. The company was founded by Henry Schein and Esther Schein in 1932 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: Henry Schein, Inc. 致力於為醫療、牙科和獸醫診所的從業人員提供醫療保健產品和服務。它透過醫療保健分銷、技術和增值服務部門運作。醫療保健分銷部門包括消耗品、實驗室、小型和大型設備維修服務、品牌和仿製藥、疫苗、外科、診斷測試、感染控制產品和維生素。科技和增值服務部門提供無追索權的財務、網路和硬體服務。該公司由 Henry Schein 和 Esther Schein 於 1932 年創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Incyte Corp. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics. It focuses on hematology and oncology, and inflammation and autoimmunity therapeutic areas. The company was founded on April 8, 1991 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Incyte Corp.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於專有療法的發現、開發和商業化。它專注於血液學和腫瘤學以及發炎和自體免疫治療領域。該公司成立於1991年4月8日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a natural resource-based building materials company, which engages in the provision of aggregates including crushed stone, sand, and gravel through its network of quarries and distribution yards. It operates through the East Group and West Group segments. The East Group segment offers aggregates and asphalt products. The West Group segment focuses on aggregates, cement, downstream products, and paving services. The company was founded on November 12, 1993 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. 是一家以自然資源為基礎的建築材料公司，透過其採石場和配送場網路提供碎石、沙子和礫石等骨材。它透過東集團和西集團部門運作。 East Group 部門提供骨材和瀝青產品。西部集團部門專注於骨材、水泥、下游產品和鋪路服務。該公司成立於1993年11月12日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: M&T Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking, trust, wealth management, and investment services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Bank, Retail Bank, Institutional Services and Wealth Management, and All Other. The Commercial Bank segment offers a wide range of credit products and banking services to middle-market and large commercial customers, mainly within the markets served by the company. The Retail Bank segment refers to the services to consumers and small businesses through the company's branch network and several other delivery channels such as telephone banking, internet banking, and ATMs. The Institutional Services and Wealth Management segment relates to helping high net worth individuals, institutions, and families grow, preserve, and transfer wealth. The All Other segment reflects other activities of the company that are not directly attributable to the reported segments. The company was founded on August 30, 1856 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: M&T Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供零售和商業銀行、信託、財富管理和投資服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行、零售銀行、機構服務和財富管理以及所有其他部門。商業銀行部門主要在公司服務的市場內向中型市場和大型商業客戶提供廣泛的信貸產品和銀行服務。零售銀行部門是指透過公司的分行網路和電話銀行、網路銀行和自動櫃員機等其他幾種交付管道向消費者和小型企業提供的服務。機構服務和財富管理部門涉及幫助高淨值個人、機構和家庭成長、保存和轉移財富。所有其他部門反映了公司不直接歸屬於報告部門的其他活動。該公司成立於 1856 年 8 月 30 日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: NVR, Inc. engages in the construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes, and condominium buildings. It operates through the following geographical segments: Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, and South East. The Mid Atlantic segment includes Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, Delaware, and Washington, D.C. The North East segment pertains to New Jersey and Eastern Pennsylvania. The Mid East segment refers to New York, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Illinois. The South East segment consists of North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Florida, Georgia, and Kentucky. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: NVR, Inc. 從事單戶獨立住宅、連棟房屋和公寓大樓的建設和銷售。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：大西洋中部、東北部、中東和東南部。大西洋中部航段包括馬裡蘭州、維吉尼亞州、西維吉尼亞州、德拉瓦州和華盛頓特區。東北航段涉及新澤西州和賓夕法尼亞州東部。中東部分是指紐約州、俄亥俄州、賓州西部、印第安納州和伊利諾州。東南部部分包括北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州、田納西州、佛羅裡達州、喬治亞州和肯塔基州。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, Asset Management Group, and Other. The Retail Banking segment offers deposit, lending, brokerage, investment management, and cash management products and services to consumer and small business customers. The Corporate and Institutional segment covers the lending, treasury management, and capital markets-related products and services to mid-sized and large corporations, government, and not-for-profit entities. The Asset Management Group segment includes personal wealth management for high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients and institutional asset management. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：零售銀行部門、企業和機構銀行部門、資產管理部門和其他部門。零售銀行部門為消費者和小型企業客戶提供存款、貸款、經紀、投資管理和現金管理產品和服務。企業和機構部門涵蓋向大中型企業、政府和非營利實體提供貸款、資金管理以及資本市場相關產品和服務。資產管理集團業務包括針對高淨值和超高淨值客戶的個人財富管理以及機構資產管理。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Regions Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in providing consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. It operates through the following segments: Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank, Wealth Management, and Other. The Corporate Bank segment represents the commercial banking functions including commercial and industrial, commercial real estate, and investor real estate lending. The Consumer Bank segment holds the branch network, including consumer banking products and services related to residential first mortgages, home equity lines and loans, small business loans, indirect loans, consumer credit cards, and other consumer loans. The Wealth Management segment offers individuals, businesses, governmental institutions and non-profit entities a range of solutions to help protect, grow and transfer wealth. The Other segment includes its treasury function, the securities portfolio, wholesale funding activities, interest rate risk management activities, and other corporate functions that are not related to a strategic business unit. The company was founded on June 26, 1970 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Regions Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供消費者和商業銀行業務、財富管理以及抵押貸款產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：企業銀行、消費者銀行、財富管理和其他部門。企業銀行部門代表商業銀行職能，包括商業和工業、商業房地產和投資者房地產貸款。消費者銀行部門擁有分行網絡，包括與住宅第一抵押貸款、房屋淨值額度和貸款、小型企業貸款、間接貸款、消費信用卡和其他消費貸款相關的消費銀行產品和服務。財富管理部門為個人、企業、政府機構和非營利實體提供一系列解決方案，協助保護、成長和轉移財富。其他部門包括其財務職能、證券投資組合、批發融資活動、利率風險管理活動以及與策略業務部門無關的其他公司職能。該公司成立於 1970 年 6 月 26 日，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: Vulcan Materials Co. engages in the production of construction aggregates. It operates through the following segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The Aggregates segment produces and sells aggregates and related products and services. The Asphalt segment relates to the production and selling of asphalt mix in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Tennessee, and Texas. The Concrete segment refers to the production and selling of ready-mixed concrete in California, Maryland, and Virginia in addition to the U.S. Virgin Islands and Washington D.C. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Vulcan Materials Co. 從事建築骨材生產。它透過以下部分運作：骨料、瀝青和混凝土。骨材部門生產和銷售骨材及相關產品和服務。瀝青部門涉及亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、新墨西哥州、田納西州和德克薩斯州的瀝青混合料的生產和銷售。混凝土部門是指在加利福尼亞州、馬裡蘭州和維吉尼亞州以及美屬維京群島和華盛頓特區生產和銷售預拌混凝土。該公司成立於 1909 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。

info.description: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in research and development activities related to general business planning, including raising capital. It focuses on the discovery of therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases. The company was founded by Thomas A. Jordan and John E. Dowling on August 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事與一般業務規劃相關的研發活動，包括募款。它專注於發現旨在治療免疫介導疾病的療法。該公司由 Thomas A. Jordan 和 John E. Dowling 於 2004 年 8 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州列剋星敦。

info.description: REalloys, Inc. is engaged in the rebuilding of domestic supply chain resilience for rare earth elements and magnets. It is involved in recycling, mining, oxide production, metallization, alloying, and magnet manufacturing. The company was founded on October 4, 2011 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: REalloys, Inc. 致力於重建稀土元素和磁鐵的國內供應鏈彈性。它涉及回收、採礦、氧化物生產、金屬化、合金化和磁鐵製造。該公司成立於2011年10月4日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Amalgamated Financial Corp. operates as a holding company for Amalgamated Bank. It offers commercial and retail banking, investment management, and trust custody segments. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Amalgamated Financial Corp. 以 Amalgamated Bank 的控股公司營運。它提供商業和零售銀行、投資管理和信託託管業務。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Amazon.com, Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in AMZN that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Amazon.com, Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與主要全球金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 AMZN 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, licensing, and globalizing biopharma innovations from around the world to deliver important medicines to patients. The company was founded Zheng Bin Yao and Stuart Lutzker on April 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Newtown Square, PA.
info.description_zh: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於識別、許可和全球化世界各地的生物製藥創新，為患者提供重要的藥物。該公司由鄭斌姚和斯圖爾特·盧茨克於 2021 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦廣場。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares 寻求与 AVGO 每日表现相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort 納斯達克生物技術尋求相當於納斯達克生物技術指數每日表現的兩倍（-2x）的每日投資結果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數是修改後的資本加權指數，包括納斯達克上市公司的證券，這些公司被分類為生物技術或製藥。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on November 1, 2024 and is headquartered Mountainside, NJ.
info.description_zh: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 1 日，總部位於新澤西州芒廷賽德。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Opportunities ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize total return through high current income exempt from federal income tax and capital appreciation. The strategy utilizes fundamental credit research to identify undervalued sectors and securities within the municipal market, maintaining the flexibility to invest across all maturities and credit qualities.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政機會 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，旨在透過免除聯邦所得稅和資本增值的高流動收入來最大化總回報。該策略利用基礎信用研究來識別市政市場內被低估的行業和證券，保持在所有期限和信用品質下進行投資的靈活性。

info.description: Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of general retail and commercial banking services. It operates through the Community Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Investment Advisory segments. The Community Banking segment includes Bank of the James which provides loans, deposits, investments and insurance to retail and commercial customers throughout the bank's market areas. The Mortgage Banking segment offers a variety of mortgage loan products principally within the bank's market areas. The Investment Advisory segment provides investment advisory and financial planning services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Lynchburg, VA.
info.description_zh: Bank of the James Financial Group, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，提供一般零售和商業銀行服務。它透過社區銀行、抵押貸款銀行和投資諮詢部門開展業務。社區銀行業務部門包括詹姆斯銀行，該銀行向該銀行整個市場領域的零售和商業客戶提供貸款、存款、投資和保險。抵押貸款銀行部門主要在銀行的市場領域內提供各種抵押貸款產品。投資諮詢部門提供投資諮詢和財務規劃服務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州林奇堡。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2030 (collectively, "2030 Bonds"). It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2030 年債券」）。它不購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2032 (collectively, "2032 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2032 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: biote Corp. is a woman-led company, which engages in providing bio identical hormone pellet therapy. It delivers a comprehensive, end-to-end platform that provides practitioners with medical education, training and certification, practice management software, and digital and point-of-care marketing support. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Biote Corp. 是一家由女性領導的公司，致力於提供生物相同的荷爾蒙顆粒療法。它提供了一個全面的端到端平台，為從業人員提供醫學教育、培訓和認證、實踐管理軟體以及數位和護理點行銷支援。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Century Aluminum Co. is a producer of aluminum and operates aluminum reduction facilities, or smelters, in the United States and Iceland. Its products include standard ingots, T-ingot, extrusion billet, horizontal direct chill ingot, molten, slab, and sow. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Century Aluminium Co. 是一家鋁生產商，在美國和冰島經營鋁還原設施或冶煉廠。其產品包括標準鋼錠、T型鋼錠、擠壓鋼坯、水平直冷鋼錠、熔煉鋼錠、板坯和母材。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: GraniteShares 1x Short COIN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -1 time (-100%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: COIN). The fund manager will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1x Short COIN Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Coinbase Global, Inc. A 類普通股（納斯達克股票代碼：COIN）每日百分比變化的 -1 倍（-100%）。基金管理人將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，基金和金融機構同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Canadian Solar, Inc. engages in the manufacture of solar photovoltaic modules, provision of solar energy and battery storage solutions, and development of utility-scale solar and battery storage products. It operates through the CSI Solar and Global Energy segments. The CSI Solar segment designs, develops, and manufactures solar ingots, wafers, cells, modules, and other solar power and battery storage products. The Global Energy segment includes solar and battery storage project development and sale, asset management services for operational projects, sale of electricity, and investment in retained assets. The company was founded by Shawn Qu in October 2001 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Canada.
info.description_zh: 阿特斯陽光電力有限公司從事太陽能光伏組件製造、提供太陽能和電池儲存解決方案以及開發公用事業規模太陽能和電池儲存產品。它透過 CSI Solar 和 Global Energy 部門運作。 CSI Solar部門設計、開發和製造太陽能錠、矽片、電池、模組以及其他太陽能和電池儲存產品。全球能源部門包括太陽能和電池儲存項目的開發和銷售、營運項目的資產管理服務、電力銷售以及保留資產的投資。該公司由Shawn Qu於2001年10月創立，總部位於加拿大基奇納。

info.description: Daily Journal Corp. engages in the business of publishing newspapers and websites reporting California and Arizona news and producing several specialized information publications. It operates through the following segments: Traditional Business, Journal Technologies, and Corporate. The Traditional Business segment includes newspapers of general circulation. The Journal Technologies segment provides case management software and related services to courts and other justice agencies. The company was founded on December 31, 1969 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Daily Journal Corp. 從事出版報道加州和亞利桑那州新聞的報紙和網站以及製作多種專業資訊出版物的業務。它透過以下部門運作：傳統業務部門、期刊技術部門和企業部門。傳統商業部門包括普遍發行的報紙。 Journal Technologies 部門向法院和其他司法機構提供案件管理軟體和相關服務。該公司成立於1969年12月31日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Dorman Products, Inc. engages in the supply of automotive replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. Its products include automotive body, steering and suspension, undercar, underhood, hardware and accessories, and heavy-duty components. The company was founded by Steven L. Berman and Richard N. Berman on October 16, 1978 and is headquartered in Colmar, PA.
info.description_zh: Dorman Products, Inc. 致力於為機動車輛售後市場產業供應汽車更換和升級零件。其產品包括汽車車身、轉向和懸吊、車底、引擎蓋、硬體和配件以及重型零件。該公司由 Steven L. Berman 和 Richard N. Berman 於 1978 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科爾馬。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the real estate sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLRE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLRE 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場房地產行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Liberty One Defensive Dividend Growth ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a non-diversified portfolio of equity securities of companies that have a strong track record of paying a rising long-term dividend. These securities will typically, but not always be, companies that the Adviser believes are "recession resistant", defensive in nature, and at the time of investment, have a strong track record of paying a rising long-term dividend income stream to investors.
info.description_zh: Liberty One 防禦性股息成長 ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常市場條件下，將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有支付不斷增長的長期股息的良好記錄的公司的非多元化股本證券投資組合。這些證券通常（但並非總是）是顧問認為具有「抗衰退性」、本質上具有防禦性的公司，並且在投資時具有向投資者支付不斷增長的長期股息收入流的良好記錄。

info.description: ECARX Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of mobility technology services. The company was founded by Zi Yu Shen & Shu Fu Li in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: ECARX Holdings, Inc. 從事行動技術服務開發。該公司由沉子宇和李樹福於2017年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of cancer immunotherapies. It focuses on its Amphiphile platform for trafficking lymph nodes. The company was founded by Darrell Irvine in August 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事癌症免疫療法的開發。它專注於其用於運輸淋巴結的 Aphiphile 平台。該公司由 Darrell Irvine 於 2011 年 8 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: First Citizens BancShares, Inc. is a bank holding company, which provides retail and commercial banking services through its subsidiaries. The company operates under the following segments: General Banking, Commercial Banking, Rail, and Corporate. The General Banking delivers services to individuals through branch networks. The Commercial Banking provides lending, leasing and other financial and advisory services to small and middle market companies. The Rail segment deals with the provision of equipment leasing and secured financing for railroads and shippers. The Corporate segment is comprised of investment securities and interest bearing cash. The company was founded on August 7, 1986 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: First Citizens BancShares, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供零售和商業銀行服務。該公司經營以下業務部門：一般銀行業務、商業銀行業務、鐵路業務和企業業務。一般銀行業務透過分行網絡向個人提供服務。商業銀行向中小型企業提供貸款、租賃及其他金融和諮詢服務。鐵路部門為鐵路和托運人提供設備租賃和擔保融資。公司部門由投資證券和計息現金組成。該公司成立於1986年8月7日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: SMI 3Fourteen Full-Cycle Trend ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is actively managed and typically owns 20 domestic stocks that are normally included in the S&P 500 Index ("S&P 500"). The FCT strategy is based on a proprietary model developed by 3Fourteen that selects stocks based on quality stock screens and trend factors such as return on capital and cash flow stability, earnings growth, return on investment, momentum, linear regression and trend analysis. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SMI 341全週期趨勢ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金採用主動式管理方式，通常持有 20 隻通常納入標準普爾 500 指數（「標準普爾 500」）的國內股票。 FCT策略是基於3Fourteen開發的專有模型，該模型根據優質股票篩選和趨勢因素（例如資本回報率和現金流穩定性、獲利成長、投資回報率、動量、線性回歸和趨勢分析）選擇股票。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Northwest Bancorp is a bank holding company which engages in the provision of commercial, mortgage, and lending activities and investment. Its offerings include saving accounts, certificate of deposits, money market, credit cards, fixed rate loans, mortgages, mutual funds, insurances and education savings accounts. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Port Angeles, WA.
info.description_zh: First Northwest Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業、抵押貸款、貸款活動和投資。其產品包括儲蓄帳戶、存款單、貨幣市場、信用卡、固定利率貸款、抵押貸款、共同基金、保險和教育儲蓄帳戶。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於華盛頓州安吉利斯港。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Bank ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq US Smart Banks IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the underlying index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the banking sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克銀行 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克美國智能銀行指數 (Nasdaq US Smart Banks IndexTM) 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成基礎指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括銀行業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Alphabet Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果與 Alphabet Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）的 100%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Grande Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in corporate finance advisory services through its subsidiary, Grande Capital. It offers IPO sponsorship and related services, and corporate financial advisory services. The company was founded on August 6, 2020 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Grande Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Grande Capital 從事企業融資諮詢服務。它提供首次公開發行保薦及相關服務以及企業財務諮詢服務。該公司成立於2020年8月6日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF seeks maximum total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in securities and financial instruments linked to the S&P 500 Index. The fund manager takes both long and short positions by investing in e-mini futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in large cap equities or investments with similar characteristics, or cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF 尋求最大的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (ETF)，旨在透過投資與標準普爾 500 指數掛鉤的證券和金融工具來實現其投資目標。基金經理人透過投資電子迷你期貨合約來持有多頭和空頭部位。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於大盤股或具有類似特徵的投資，或現金及現金等價物。

info.description: Hancock Whitney Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It also offers trust and investment management services to retirement plans, corporations, individuals, brokerage services, annuity products, life insurance, general insurance and agency services, including life, title insurance and consumer financing service. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Gulfport, MS.
info.description_zh: Hancock Whitney Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供金融服務。它還為退休計劃、企業、個人提供信託和投資管理服務、經紀服務、年金產品、人壽保險、一般保險和代理服務，包括人壽、產權保險和消費者融資服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於密西西比州格爾夫波特。

info.description: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, exporting, and retailing alcoholic and non-alcoholic brands. The company was founded by Meena Beri, Amit Beri and Sahil Beri on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Seven Hills, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. 從事酒精和非酒精品牌的開發、製造、行銷、出口和零售。該公司由 Meena Beri、Amit Beri 和 Sahil Beri 於 2018 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於澳洲七山。

info.description: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. engages in the research and development of oncology-focused precision medicine. The firm focuses on the targeted therapeutics for patients selected using molecular diagnostics. Its product candidate, IDE196, is a protein kinase C inhibitor for genetically defined cancers having GNAQ and GNA11 gene mutations. The company was founded by Yujiro S. Hata and Jeffrey Hager in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc.從事以腫瘤學為重點的精準醫療的研發。該公司專注於為使用分子診斷選擇的患者提供標靶治療。其候選產品 IDE196 是一種蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑，用於治療具有 GNAQ 和 GNA11 基因突變的基因癌症。該公司由 Yujiro S. Hata 和 Jeffrey Hager 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on August 8, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月8日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Ingles Markets, Inc. engages in the operation of a supermarket chain in Georgia, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and Alabama. It offers its products through the following categories: grocery, non-foods, perishables and other. The grocery products consist of groceries, dairy, and frozen foods. The non-foods products include alcoholic beverages, tobacco, pharmacy, health, beauty, and cosmetic products. The perishable products include meat, produce, deli, and bakery. The other category consists of fluid dairy operations and shopping center rentals. The company was founded by Robert P. Ingle in 1963 and is headquartered in Black Mountain, NC.
info.description_zh: Ingles Markets, Inc. 在喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、田納西州、維吉尼亞州和阿拉巴馬州從事連鎖超市的經營。它提供以下類別的產品：雜貨、非食品、易腐爛食品等。雜貨產品包括雜貨、乳製品和冷凍食品。非食品產品包括酒精飲料、菸草、藥品、保健、美容和化妝品。易腐爛的產品包括肉類、農產品、熟食店和麵包店。另一類包括流體乳製品業務和購物中心租賃。該公司由 Robert P. Ingle 於 1963 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州黑山。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Jpmorgan Healthcare Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare services, healthcare technology, medical technology and life sciences companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the equity securities of healthcare companies.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通醫療保健領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於製藥、生物技術、醫療保健服務、醫療保健技術、醫療技術和生命科學公司發行的股票證券，顧問認為這些公司處於領先地位，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於醫療保健公司的股權證券。

info.description: Invesco KBW Bank ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index of companies primarily engaged in U.S. banking activities, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of large national U.S. money centers, regional banks, and thrift institutions that are publicly traded in the U.S. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Bank ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克銀行指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事美國銀行業務的公司的修正市值加權指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易的大型國家級貨幣中心、地區銀行和儲蓄機構的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco KBW Property & Casualty Insurance ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Property & Casualty IndexTM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index designed to track the performance of companies primarily engaged in U.S. property and casualty insurance activities, as determined by the index provider. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Property & Casualty Insurance ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW Nasdaq Property & Casualty Index™（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是修正市值加權指數，旨在追蹤主要從事美國財產和傷亡保險活動的公司的業績，由指數提供者決定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LAC Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LAC. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LAC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LAC 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LAC 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LAC 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Ltd. engages in the management and development of casino gaming and entertainment resort facilities. It operates through the following segments: City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha and Other, City of Dreams Manila, City of Dreams Mediterranean & Other, Other Operations, and Corporate & Other. The company was founded by Yau Lung Ho in December 2004 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 新濠博亞娛樂有限公司從事賭場博彩及娛樂度假村設施的管理與開發。該公司透過以下部門運作：新濠天地、新濠影匯、澳門新濠鋒、摩卡及其他、馬尼拉新濠天地、地中海新濠天地及其他、其他業務部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由何遊龍於2004年12月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: MiniMed Group, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of a wide range of medical devices and solutions for diabetes management. Its offerings include insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitoring systems, infusion sets, software platforms, and related accessories that help patients and healthcare providers effectively monitor and control blood glucose levels. The company was founded by Alfred E. Mann in 1983 and is headquartered in Northridge, CA.
info.description_zh: MiniMed Group, Inc. 從事各種糖尿病管理醫療設備和解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括胰島素幫浦、連續血糖監測系統、輸液器、軟體平台和相關配件，幫助患者和醫療保健提供者有效監測和控制血糖水平。該公司由 Alfred E. Mann 於 1983 年創立，總部位於加州北嶺。

info.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development, and marketing of transformative molecular diagnostic tests. The company was founded by Walter A. Gilbert, Mark H. Skolnick, and Peter D. Meldrum in May 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Myriad Genetics, Inc. 從事變革性分子診斷測試的發現、開發和行銷。該公司由 Walter A. Gilbert、Mark H. Skolnick 和 Peter D. Meldrum 於 1991 年 5 月創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: NioCorp Developments Ltd. engages in the evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral deposits. It focuses on a super alloy materials project in Nebraska for producing niobium, scandium, and titanium. The company was founded on February 27, 1987, and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: NioCorp Developments Ltd. 從事礦藏的評估、收購、勘探和開發。它專注於內布拉斯加州的一個生產鈮、鈧和鈦的超級合金材料項目。該公司成立於1987年2月27日，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to NVDA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 NVDA 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Newell Brands, Inc. is a global consumer goods company, which engages in the business of manufacturing, marketing, and selling consumer and commercial products. It operates through the following segments: Home and Commercial Solutions, Learning and Development, Outdoor and Recreation, and Corporate. The Home and Commercial Solutions segment includes designing, manufacturing, sourcing, marketing, and distributing a diverse line of household products including kitchen appliances, food and home storage, fresh preserving, vacuum sealing, gourmet cookware, bakeware, cutlery, and home fragrance products, as well as commercial cleaning and maintenance solutions products, closet and garage organization products, hygiene systems, and material handling solutions. The Learning and Development segment focuses on writing instruments including markers, highlighters, pens, and pencils, art products, activity-based products, labeling solutions, baby gear, and infant care products. The Outdoor and Recreation segment offers global consumer active lifestyle products for outdoor and outdoor-related activities including technical apparel and on-the-go beverageware. The Corporate segment provides general corporate services. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Newell Brands, Inc. 是一家全球消費品公司，從事製造、行銷和銷售消費品和商業產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：家庭和商業解決方案部門、學習和發展部門、戶外和休閒部門以及企業部門。家庭和商業解決方案部門包括設計、製造、採購、行銷和分銷各種家用產品，包括廚房電器、食品和家庭儲存、保鮮、真空密封、美食炊具、烘焙用具、餐具和家用香薰產品，以及商業清潔和維護解決方案產品、壁櫥和車庫組織產品、衛生系統和材料處理解決方案。學習和發展部門專注於書寫工具，包括記號筆、螢光筆、鋼筆和鉛筆、藝術產品、基於活動的產品、標籤解決方案、嬰兒用品和嬰兒護理產品。戶外和休閒部門為全球消費者提供用於戶外和戶外相關活動的積極生活方式產品，包括技術服裝和隨身飲料。企業部門提供一般企業服務。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Optex Systems Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of manufacturing optical sighting systems and assemblies for the Department of Defense, foreign military applications, and commercial markets. It operates through the following segments: Optex Systems Richardson and Applied Optics Center Dallas. The Optex Systems Richardson segment handles optical sighting systems and assemblies' production. The Applied Optics Center Dallas segment serves as the key supplier of laser coated filters used in the production of periscope assemblies. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Optex Systems Holdings, Inc. 從事為國防部、外國軍事應用和商業市場製造光學瞄準系統和組件的業務。它透過以下部門運作：Optex Systems Richardson 和達拉斯應用光學中心。 Optex Systems Richardson 部門負責光學瞄準系統和組件的生產。達拉斯應用光學中心分部是用於生產潛望鏡組件的雷射鍍膜濾光片的主要供應商。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OSCR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OSCR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OSCR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OSCR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 OSCR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 200% 的 OSCR 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Oscar Health, Inc. - Class A (NYSE: OSCR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") where the fund manager attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. It aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long OSCR ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Oscar Health, Inc. - A 類（NYSE：OSCR）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），基金經理人試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它的目標是在一天內實現每日百分比變化，而不是在任何其他時期內實現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Proficient Auto Logistics, Inc. is a freight company, which engages in providing auto transportation and logistics services. Its transport services include open carrier, enclosed car shipping, cross country car shipping, and dealer relocation. It operates through the Company Drivers and Brokered segments. The Company Drivers segment offers automobile transport and contract services under an asset-based model. The Brokered segment refers to the transportation services utilizing an asset-light model focusing on outsourcing transportation of loads to third-party carriers. The Company was founded on June 13, 2023 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, FL.
info.description_zh: Proficient Auto Logistics, Inc.是一家貨運公司，從事提供汽車運輸和物流服務。其運輸服務包括開放式承運、封閉式汽車運輸、越野汽車運輸和經銷商搬遷。它透過公司司機和經紀部門運作。公司司機部門在基於資產的模式下提供汽車運輸和合約服務。經紀業務是指利用輕資產模式的運輸服務，重點在於將貨物運輸外包給第三方承運人。該公司成立於2023年6月13日，總部位於佛羅裡達州傑克遜維爾。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block World Pharma And Biotech Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA Global Pharma and Biotech Select Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industries with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's net assets in component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投資組合建構模組世界製藥和生技指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA 全球製藥和生技精選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數未計費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的製藥和/或生物技術行業的公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的基金淨資產投資於構成指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ US BuyBack AchieversTM Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The NASDAQ includes common stocks in the underlying index pursuant to a proprietary selection methodology that identifies a universe of "BuyBack Achievers TM".
info.description_zh: Invesco BuyBack Achievers ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克美國 BuyBack AchieversTM 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克根據專有的選擇方法將普通股納入基礎指數中，該方法確定了「BuyBack Achievers TM」的範圍。

info.description: Preformed Line Products Co. engages in the provision of products and systems employed in the construction and maintenance of overhead and underground networks for the energy, telecommunication, cable operators, information, and other similar industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: PLP-USA, Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. The PLP-USA segment is involved in manufacturing traditional products primarily supporting domestic energy, telecommunications, and solar products. The Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific segments focuses on supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication, and solar products in each respective geographical region. The company was founded by Thomas F. Peterson in 1947 and is headquartered in Mayfield Village, OH.
info.description_zh: Preformed Line Products Co. 致力於為能源、電信、電纜運營商、資訊和其他類似行業提供用於架空和地下網路建設和維護的產品和系統。它透過以下地理區域運作：PLP-USA、美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。 PLP-USA 部門從事製造主要支持國內能源、電信和太陽能產品的傳統產品。美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區則專注於支援各個地理區域的能源、電信、數據通訊和太陽能產品。該公司由 Thomas F. Peterson 於 1947 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州梅菲爾德村。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. engages in transforming the drug discovery process with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Its Dynamo platform is use to integrate an array of edge experimental and computational approaches, which allows to apply the understanding of protein structure and motion to drug discovery. The company was founded by David Elliot Shaw, Matthew P. Jacobson, Dorothee Kern, Mark Murcko, Alexis Borisy, and Jakob Loven on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於改變藥物發現過程，最初的重點是增強靶向腫瘤學中的小分子治療發現。其 Dynamo 平台用於整合一系列邊緣實驗和計算方法，從而可以將對蛋白質結構和運動的理解應用於藥物發現。該公司由 David Elliot Shaw、Matthew P. Jacobson、Dorothee Kern、Mark Murcko、Alexis Borisy 和 Jakob Loven 於 2015 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Siebert Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of brokerage and financial advisory services. It conducts the following lines of business through wholly owned subsidiaries: Retail Brokerage Business, Investment Advisory Services, Insurance Services, Robo-Advisory Technology Development, and Prime Brokerage Services. The company was founded by Siebert Muriel F. on April 9, 1934 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Siebert Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供經紀和財務諮詢服務。它透過全資子公司開展以下業務：零售經紀業務、投資諮詢服務、保險服務、機器人諮詢技術開發和大宗經紀服務。該公司由 Siebert Muriel F. 於 1934 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: Sanofi engages in the research, production, and distribution of pharmaceutical products. It operates through the Biopharma segment, which comprises commercial operations and research, development and production activities relating to the specialty care, general medicines and vaccines franchises plus support and corporate functions, for all geographical territories. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: 賽諾菲從事醫藥產品的研究、生產和分銷。該公司透過生物製藥部門運營，該部門包括與所有地理區域的專業護理、普通藥物和疫苗特許經營權以及支持和公司職能相關的商業運營以及研究、開發和生產活動。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Sportradar Group AG engages in the provision of sports betting and entertainment products and services. Its products include Betting Technology & Solutions and Sports Content, Technology & Services. The company was founded by Carsten Marcus Koerl in 2001 and is headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Sportradar Group AG 從事提供體育博彩和娛樂產品及服務。其產品包括博彩技術和解決方案以及體育內容、技術和服務。該公司由 Carsten Marcus Koerl 於 2001 年創立，總部位於瑞士聖加侖。

info.description: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. engages in the provision of construction solutions. It operates through the following segments: Transportation Solutions, E-Infrastructure Solutions, and Building Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment includes infrastructure and rehabilitation projects for highways, roads, bridges, airports, ports, light rail, water, wastewater, and storm drainage systems. The E-Infrastructure Solutions projects develop advanced, large-scale site development systems and services for data centers, e-commerce distribution centers, warehousing, transportation, energy, and more. The Building Solutions segment projects include residential and commercial concrete foundations for single-family and multi-family homes, parking structures, elevated slabs, and other concrete work. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Sterling Infrastructure, Inc. 從事提供建築解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運輸解決方案、電子基礎設施解決方案和建築解決方案。交通解決方案部門包括高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場、港口、輕軌、水、廢水和暴雨排水系統的基礎設施和修復項目。電子基礎設施解決方案專案為資料中心、電子商務配送中心、倉儲、運輸、能源等開發先進的大型站點開發系統和服務。建築解決方案部門專案包括單戶和多戶住宅的住宅和商業混凝土基礎、停車場結構、高架板和其他混凝土工程。該公司成立於 1955 年，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: thredUP, Inc. operates as an online clothing resale platform for apparel, shoes, and accessories. Its brands include J.Crew, Ann Taylor, Banana Republic, Lululemon Athletica, Talbots, and Madewell. It operates through the United States and Others geographical segments. The company was founded by James Reinhart, Chris Homer, and Oliver Lubin in January 2009 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: thredUP, Inc. 是一家線上服裝轉售平台，銷售服裝、鞋子和配件。其品牌包括 J.Crew、Ann Taylor、Banana Republic、Lululemon Athletica、Talbots 和 Madewell。它透過美國和其他地區的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 James Reinhart、Chris Homer 和 Oliver Lubin 於 2009 年 1 月創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: TJGC Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of marketing and advertising services. It offers one-stop advertising services to clients throughout the entire advertising process, which comprises the planning, creating, launching, managing, and performance monitoring of the advertisements. The company was founded by Kai Kwan Lam, Chi Fung Lau, and Chun Pong Siu on May 13, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: TJGC Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事提供行銷和廣告服務。為客戶提供廣告規劃、創作、投放、管理、成效監控等整個廣告流程的一站式廣告服務。該公司由林啟君、劉志峰和俊邦蕭於2022年5月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of health care companies.
